title: World as a System: 1000 Reasoning Problems for Grades 1–4 · Why read this book?

readerInvitation.reasonToExist: Its thousand problems supply facts, rules, and questions across four primary-school grades.
readerOutcomes: The task is to explain why an answer follows, rather than guess a plausible result.
An irrelevant museum fact changes no coordinate, giving children a simple test of relevance.
The same habit is to keep every relevant condition visible before concluding.
The worked solutions provide models to test and discuss, rather than an infallible answer key.
